metadata.title: Online Retail Marketplace Deployment and Operating Surfaces
metadata.description: Primary deployment, distribution, support, and integration channels used to deliver and operate the Online Retail Marketplace domain.
productScopeNotes: p6 (Marketplace Trust & Operations Consoles) is scoped to trust, enforcement, identity, promise-recovery, and case-resolution bricks (orde, deli, risk, auth, care, iden). It does not own the returns (retu), FBA (fbao), inventory (invn), seller-fulfilled (supp), analytics (anal), or reporting (repr) runtimes.
Operators consume those capabilities through p2, p4, and p5 rather than a duplicate p6 runtime; see products.json p6.consumesProductsForOperations.
